policy: Generated SVG sheets are the default shipped CyberWorld art. External sources are reference/inspiration lanes only unless their license is verified before importing specific files.

sources.name: NASA Images and Media Guidelines
sources.license_summary: NASA content is generally not subject to U.S. copyright for many uses, but NASA insignia/endorsement/personality rights restrictions still apply.
sources.use_in_cyberworld: Mars launch, rover, habitat, telemetry, mission control, and aerospace visual references. Avoid implying NASA endorsement.

sources.name: Kenney Game Assets
sources.license_summary: Kenney states asset-page game assets are public domain licensed CC0 and usable commercially.
sources.use_in_cyberworld: UI, props, vehicles, tiles, and neutral game objects if downloaded with license files preserved.

sources.name: OpenGameArt CC0 collections
sources.license_summary: OpenGameArt hosts assets under multiple free licenses; verify each item. Prefer CC0 assets for CyberWorld imports.
sources.use_in_cyberworld: Cyberpunk tiles, characters, portraits, backgrounds, and effects after per-asset license verification.

sources.name: OpenGameArt Cyberpunk Tileset and Assets
sources.license_summary: Useful cyberpunk reference candidate. License must be verified on the asset page before direct import.
sources.use_in_cyberworld: Mood, props, city panels, wall/floor shapes, and neon environment references.

sources.name: OpenGameArt Warped City
sources.license_summary: Cyberpunk platformer reference candidate. License must be verified on the asset page before direct import.
sources.use_in_cyberworld: Movement, city tiles, vehicle silhouettes, enemy animation expectations, and background layering reference.

sources.name: Font Awesome Free License
sources.license_summary: Font Awesome Free uses separate licenses for icons, fonts, and code; preserve attribution/license requirements if files are imported.
sources.use_in_cyberworld: Reference for clear UI icon silhouettes; direct import requires license attribution hygiene.
